title: Black Belt · Mockup C — the Undo payment box names the payment (BB3)
subtitle: Drawn on the real preview box (fake data). Today the title is built from the plan's installments, so one $870 card payment that paid all three reads "Undo payment 1 + Payment 2 + Payment 3?". Now that the roster row's ⋯ opens this box too (mockup A), it must say clearly which person and which payment: amount, how, when. One question: which title? The buttons stay as today here; Part 2 (BB7, the shared box) makes them Keep payment · Undo payment.

items.caption: PC, Mia Chen: one card payment for payments 1–3.
PC, Sam Lee: one check for payment 1 — "Undo payment 1?" says nothing about the money.

columns.label: A · the person and the payment (recommended)

items.caption: "Undo Mia Chen’s $870 card payment?" — Recorded on Mar 20 for payments 1, 2 and 3. It comes off the balance; the history keeps it.
"Undo Sam Lee’s $330 check payment?" — Recorded on Mar 27 for payment 1.

columns.note: Green: the new words. Pro: Star's own shape ("Undo Mia Chen’s payment?", G16) with the amount and how added, so the sections read alike; the name in the title catches a tap on the wrong roster row — the new risk once the row's ⋯ can undo. Con: the date is in the second line, not the title.

columns.label: B · the payment first

items.caption: "Undo the $870 card payment from Mar 20?" — It was for payments 1, 2 and 3. It comes off Mia Chen’s balance; the history keeps it.
"Undo the $330 check payment from Mar 27?" — It was for payment 1.

columns.note: Green: the new words. Pro: amount, how and when all in the title — the most exact name for the payment. Con: the person is only in the second line, and it no longer matches Star's box.

footer: Same for both options: "for payments 1, 2 and 3" / "for payment 1" / "in full" / "for the Kukkiwon certificate" follow what the payment was for (the detail's "For" column). How: cash · check · card payment. Undo refund and Undo returned mark keep their own titles (Part 2, BB7). After Undo, the toast stays as today: "Payment 1 + Payment 2 + Payment 3 undone · $870 · Mia Chen" (its words follow the chosen title in the build).
